speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for National Development when will the review of the Animals and Birds Act 1965 and the Code of Animal Welfare be completed.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, could I check with the Minister, what is taking so long?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Is there something that is delaying the completion of this review?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Second, the Minister had mentioned that they are going to consult widely.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Could I check when the public consultations will be and also when will we be consulting the animal welfare groups, the vets and all the various stakeholders, including animal trainers as well?

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: It includes not just a review of penalties, but also zoonosis prevention and control, and other areas as articulated earlier.
